answer: Rule: each identity must pass a rotating audit committee every epoch. Five random established agents attest its work, and any attestor who vouched for a proven fake loses a 20-unit stake. A fake must buy five fresh attestations each epoch, like a boat clearing a new jetty on every tide, so one fake costs at least 100 units per epoch and 1,000 fakes cost 100,000 units per epoch. Honest agents pass once and keep earning in the open meadow.
